Brand and operating-system marks
================================

These files are third-party brand marks, used nominatively to identify the
agent or operating system a pane or host belongs to. Trademarks remain the
property of their respective owners; vendoring the glyph is not an endorsement
and does not transfer any trademark right.

Each file has had its fixed pixel width/height and CSS class attributes removed
so the stylesheet controls size and colour. Path data is unmodified.

claude.svg, openai.svg
----------------------

linux.svg
---------
Simple Icons — https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons

Released under CC0 1.0 Universal. To the extent possible under law, the authors
have waived all copyright and related or neighboring rights to the icon files.
See https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

apple.svg, ubuntu.svg, windows.svg
----------------------------------
Lineicons (Basic / free set) — https://github.com/LineiconsHQ/Lineicons
MIT License; the full text is in ../icons/LICENSE.txt, which covers the same
set. These files were normalised the same way: hardcoded hex replaced with
`currentColor`, fixed width/height removed.

Lineicons carries no OpenAI or Claude mark, which is why those two come from
Bootstrap Icons above, and no generic Linux mark, which is why Tux comes from
Simple Icons.
